audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read "Skill" while win[0..6] reads Skill then Cassiopeia x6, and every phases[N].why described Galio winning the stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches win[] exactly. Sides aligned to win[]; the six Cassiopeia rows' whys are rewritten in the same proposal so no row argues with itself.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side Skill (unchanged verdict, explicit), phases[1..6].side Cassiopeia, with whys[1..6] rewritten to her kit and ratings dropped to 4/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike whys were generic Galio boilerplate with no Cassiopeia timing in them.
audit.why: Her spikes are Miasma at 24s->16s (grounding kills Justice Punch), Twin Fang at 0.75s with healing, and Petrifying Gaze at 120/100/80s which only stuns targets facing her.
audit.corrected: Level 3, 4-5, 6, first-item and two-item whys now name the ability and the cooldown that owns each stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and never stated that Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her — the single most actionable interaction in the matchup.
audit.why: Riot's R text: stuns enemies in front of her that are facing her, slows those with their back turned. Miasma's grounding disables Justice Punch outright.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Miasma 24s/16s, Petrifying Gaze 120s with the facing condition, and Twin Fang's 0.75s (no punish window).

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said "Add anti-heal early into his sustain" — misgendered and unattributed.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt on every 0.75s cast, which is what makes extended trades unwinnable without Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Names Oblivion Orb and attributes the healing to Twin Fang.

audit.why: Packet suspectName on wants.foe[2] ('Land Petrifying Gaze') is a false positive — that is her real R name.
